references.text: The Lord's Spirit came upon Othniel, and he became a judge in Israel—the same expression for the Spirit's empowerment for leadership
The Lord's Spirit came upon Jephthah—parallel to how the Spirit came upon Gideon to empower him for battle
The Lord's Spirit came upon Samson with power—the same pattern of the Spirit's empowerment for Israel's judges
The Lord's Spirit came upon Samson—a repeated example of the Spirit's powerful work during the time of the judges
God's Spirit came upon Saul when he heard the message, and he gathered Israel for battle—a similar pattern to that with Gideon
The Lord's Spirit came upon David from the day he was anointed—the Spirit's empowerment for leadership in Israel
The Spirit came upon Amasai and he spoke—the Spirit clothed him, using the same Hebrew expression as with Gideon
God's Spirit clothed Zechariah—exactly the same Hebrew expression (לָבְשָׁה) used regarding Gideon
Description of the silver trumpets to be used for calling the assembly together and for war—Gideon used a shofar for the same purpose
Jesus promises that the disciples will be clothed with power from on high—a similar image of being clothed with the Spirit's power
